user.title: Connect Internxt
user.description: Log in with your Internxt account. Backups need an Internxt **Ultimate** or **Pro Business** plan, other plans do not allow access by third-party apps. Your password is only used to log in and is not stored. No suitable plan yet? [Get Internxt here]({upgrade_url}).

data_description.email: The e-mail address of your Internxt account.
data_description.password: Your Internxt password. It decrypts your account key once and is then discarded.

two_factor.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor.description: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app. Every wrong code counts as a failed login at Internxt; after 10 failed logins the account is locked.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Internxt again
reauth_confirm.description: The connection to Internxt for {email} has expired. Enter your password to log in again.

error.invalid_auth: E-mail or password is wrong. Every failed attempt counts toward Internxt's account lock after 10 failures, so please check before trying again.
error.invalid_2fa: The 2FA code was not accepted. Wait for a fresh code and try again.
error.plan_not_supported: Your Internxt plan does not allow access by third-party apps. Home Assistant backups need Internxt Ultimate or Pro Business, available at {upgrade_url}
error.account_blocked: Internxt has locked this account after too many failed logins. Only Internxt support can unlock it.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Internxt. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.preflight_failed: Login worked, but the connection test (create folder, upload and download a small file) failed. Details are in the Home Assistant log.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Details are in the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Internxt account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different Internxt account than the one set up here.

auth_failed.message: Internxt rejected the login. Please log in again.

account_unusable.message: The Internxt account cannot be used for backups (plan or account lock): {error}. Suitable plans: {upgrade_url}

quota_exceeded.message: Not enough space in Internxt for this backup: {error}

update_failed.message: Could not read the Internxt storage usage: {error}

entry_not_found.message: No Internxt account with the ID {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Internxt account {title} is not loaded.

no_access_to_path.message: Home Assistant is not allowed to read {filename}. Use a folder like /media or /config/www, or add it to allowlist_external_dirs.

file_exists.message: {path} already exists in Internxt. Turn on overwrite to replace it.

upload.name: Upload files
upload.description: Uploads files from Home Assistant to Internxt, encrypted on this device. Only files in allowed folders (for example /media or /config/www) can be uploaded.

config_entry_id.name: Internxt account
config_entry_id.description: The Internxt account to upload to.

filename.name: Files
filename.description: Full paths of the files to upload.

destination_folder.name: Destination folder
destination_folder.description: Folder in Internxt, subfolders separated by /. Missing folders are created.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace a file with the same name; the old version is moved to the Internxt trash.

delete.name: Delete files
delete.description: Deletes files in Internxt. By default they are moved to the Internxt trash.

config_entry_id.name: Internxt account
config_entry_id.description: The Internxt account to delete from.

path.name: Paths
path.description: Paths of the files in Internxt, for example Home Assistant Uploads/front_door.jpg.

permanently.name: Delete permanently
permanently.description: Delete right away instead of moving to the trash. This cannot be undone.
